#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: --from-stage <s> rehydrates completed-stage artifacts before dispatching <s>.
# (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5 / _runner_from_stage_preflight)
#
# SPEC-3 [code]: --from-stage <s> rehydrates all stages before <s> via
#   _artifact_persist_restore and _artifact_persist_put_back, places their
#   artifacts in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR, dispatches <s> as the first stage, and
#   emits no stage.start for any earlier stage.
#
# SPEC-4 [code]: --from-stage <s> when a stage before <s> has no restorable
#   artifact exits 1 before dispatching anything and names the missing stage
#   in stderr.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
RUNNER="$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/runner.sh"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/state/artifact-persist.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/state/artifact-persist.sh"

print_test_header "from-stage-rehydrate — artifact restore on --from-stage (#1805)"
setup_test_env "from-stage-rehydrate-1805"
export ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn

# ── SPEC-3: --from-stage rehydrates stages before <s> from git state branch ──
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-3] --from-stage rehydrates prior-stage artifacts and skips their stage.start"

S3_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S3_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-state"
S3_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-events"
S3_EVENTS_JSONL="$S3_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S3_STATE_FILE="$S3_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S3_EVENTS_DIR"

# Create a git repo; _artifact_persist_snapshot writes the state branch here.
S3_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo fs-rehydrate-s3)"
install_template_overlay "$S3_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

# Create mock plugins.
mock_plugin_factory "intake" "agent" 0 >/dev/null
mock_plugin_factory "build"  "agent" 0 >/dev/null
# cycled sub-stage used by the artifact-snapshot-coverage cyclic fixture (SPEC-13 sub-case).
mock_plugin_factory "cycled" "agent" 0 "" "builder" >/dev/null
S3_PLUGINS_ROOT="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/plugins"

# Create the intake primary artifact so the snapshot picks it up.
printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Snapshot onto the state branch in S3_WORK_REPO.
_s3_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S3_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S3_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S3_STATE_DIR" "$S3_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s3_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s3_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "[#1805/SPEC-3] setup: snapshot to state branch failed" \
        "rc=$_s3_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
else
    assert_pass "[#1805/SPEC-3] setup: state branch populated"
fi

# Remove the artifact from disk; it now lives only on the state branch.
rm -f "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Write state file: intake=complete, build=pending, status=in_progress.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s3-fs-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S3_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S3_STATE_FILE"

# Run runner with --from-stage build. CWD=S3_WORK_REPO so the state branch
# is reachable. Artifact must be restored before build dispatches.
set +e
( cd "$S3_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S3_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S3_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S3_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal \
        --resume --from-stage build --issue "$S3_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-stderr.txt"
_s3_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: intake artifact must be in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after --from-stage.
# Before the change: no rehydration → file absent → FAILS.
# After the change: _runner_from_stage_preflight restores it → PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-3] intake-result.json rehydrated into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR via --from-stage" \
    "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: the restored artifact must carry the payload originally snapshotted to
# the git state branch — this proves _artifact_persist_restore read from git and
# _artifact_persist_put_back placed it in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR (not re-created fresh by
# the runner through any other mechanism).
# Before the change: no restore → file absent → content="" → FAILS.
# After the change: git state restore → original content present → PASSES.
_s3_restored_content="$(cat "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"
assert_contains \
    "[#1805/SPEC-3] restored artifact contains original payload (proves _artifact_persist_restore + _artifact_persist_put_back used git state branch)" \
    "$_s3_restored_content" "prior-run intake"

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: intake must emit no stage.start event (it was skipped).
# Before the change: no rehydration means intake might be re-dispatched → stage.start emitted → FAILS.
# After the change: intake is complete and skipped entirely → no stage.start → PASSES.
_s3_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s3_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start" and .data.stage=="intake") | .type' \
        "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-3] intake emits no stage.start when skipped via --from-stage" \
    "0" "$_s3_intake_starts"

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: build must be the FIRST stage dispatched (stage.start with stage==build).
# Before the change: without rehydration the runner may re-dispatch intake first → FAILS.
# After the change: intake is skipped; build (the --from-stage target) is first → PASSES.
_s3_first_dispatched=""
if [[ -f "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    # Use jq -rs to slurp all objects and pick .[0] — avoids | head (SIGPIPE-prone).
    _s3_first_dispatched="$(jq -rs \
        'map(select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty) | .[0] // ""' \
        "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null || true)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-3] build is the first dispatched stage (--from-stage target, intake skipped)" \
    "build" "$_s3_first_dispatched"

# ── SPEC-4: missing artifact with --from-stage exits 1 and names missing stage ─
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-4] --from-stage with no restorable artifact exits 1 naming missing stage"

S4_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S4_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-state"
S4_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-events"
S4_EVENTS_JSONL="$S4_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S4_STATE_FILE="$S4_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S4_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S4_EVENTS_DIR"

# Fresh repo with no state branch for S4_ID — no artifact anywhere.
S4_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo fs-rehydrate-s4)"
install_template_overlay "$S4_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

# State: intake=complete, build=pending, NO artifact on disk, NO state branch.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s4-fs-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S4_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S4_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$S4_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S4_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S4_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S4_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S4_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal \
        --resume --from-stage build --issue "$S4_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-stderr.txt"
_s4_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-4]: runner must exit 1 when prior stage has no restorable artifact.
# Before the change: runner has no preflight check → continues → exits 0 → FAILS.
# After the change: _runner_from_stage_preflight exits 1 → PASSES.
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-4] --from-stage exits 1 when prior stage has no restorable artifact" \
    "1" "$_s4_rc"

# [#1805/SPEC-4]: stderr must name the missing stage ("intake").
_s4_stderr="$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-stderr.txt" 2>/dev/null || true)"
assert_contains \
    "[#1805/SPEC-4] stderr names the missing stage (intake)" \
    "$_s4_stderr" "intake"

# [#1805/SPEC-4]: no stage.start must be emitted before the exit.
_s4_any_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S4_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s4_any_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .type' \
        "$S4_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-4] no stage.start emitted before exit 1" \
    "0" "$_s4_any_starts"

# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
print_test_section "from-stage-rehydrate test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

# Run a fresh pipeline against the cyclic fixture (artifact-snapshot-coverage) to
# demonstrate that this test file exercises a pipeline containing a cyclic stage.
_S13_FS_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
_S13_FS_WORK="$(setup_git_temp_repo fs-s13-cycle-check)"
install_template_overlay "$_S13_FS_WORK" artifact-snapshot-coverage

_S13_FS_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-state"
_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-events"
_S13_FS_EVENTS_JSONL="$_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
_S13_FS_STATE_FILE="$_S13_FS_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$_S13_FS_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s13fs-fresh-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_S13_FS_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {}, current_iteration: 0, self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "", cost_ledger_pointer: 0, claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {}, status: "in_progress", updated_at: $now
    }' > "$_S13_FS_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$_S13_FS_WORK" && env \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$_S13_FS_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$_S13_FS_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$_S13_FS_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template artifact-snapshot-coverage --issue "$_S13_FS_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-stderr.txt"
set -e

# : the fixture is cyclic (type: cycle present).
_s13_fs_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
assert_contains "from-stage-rehydrate test uses a cyclic fixture (type: cycle)" \
    "$_s13_fs_content" "type: cycle"

# : confirm the cyclic pipeline ran (intake dispatched in the fresh run).
_s13_fs_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$_S13_FS_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' || echo 0)"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Tests: resume rehydrates completed-stage artifacts from the git state branch
3	# before the dispatch loop. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)
4	#
5	# SPEC-1 [code]: on resume, runner calls _artifact_persist_restore +
6	#   _artifact_persist_put_back and places completed-stage artifacts into
7	#   ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the dispatch loop; the complete stage emits
8	#   no stage.start event.
9	#
10	# SPEC-2 [code]: a complete stage whose primary artifact is absent from both
11	#   disk and the git state branch causes the resume to exit 1 before any
12	#   stage.start event is emitted.
13	#
14	# SPEC-5 [no-code]: ADR-006-resume-contract.md amended with step 3.5:
15	#   before the dispatch loop the runner restores completed-stage artifacts from
16	#   the git state branch; a still-absent artifact causes exit 1; enforcing

423	# Extract §6 from ADR-050: content from the "### 6." heading up to (not including) "### 7."
424	_adr050_s6="$(awk \
425	    '/^### 6\./{p=1} p && /^### [0-9]+\./ && !/^### 6\./{exit} p{print}' \
426	    "$ADR_050" 2>/dev/null || true)"
427	
428	# [#1805/SPEC-6]: §6 boundary note must say the invariant applies to new runs
429	# and that a resume is governed by ADR-006.
430	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note says invariant applies to new runs" \
431	    "$_adr050_s6" "new run"
432	
433	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note names ADR-006 as governing resume" \
434	    "$_adr050_s6" "ADR-006"
435	
436	# [#1805/SPEC-6]: §6 must say "a resume continues the same run" (not just reference ADR-006).
437	# Before the doc change: clause absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
438	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note says a resume continues the same run" \
439	    "$_adr050_s6" "continues the same run"
440	
441	# ── SPEC-12: fresh (non-resume) run dispatches all stages ─────────────────────
442	print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh non-resume run dispatches all stages (ADR-050 §6 new-run side)"
443	
444	S12_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-state"
445	S12_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-events"
446	S12_EVENTS_JSONL="$S12_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
447	S12_STATE_FILE="$S12_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
448	mkdir -p "$S12_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S12_EVENTS_DIR"
449	
450	_S12_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
451	S12_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-fresh-work)"
452	# Use a cycle fixture so SPEC-12 and SPEC-13 use the same cyclic pipeline.
453	# artifact-snapshot-coverage has intake (leaf) + cyc (cycle); that satisfies SPEC-13.
454	install_template_overlay "$S12_WORK_REPO" artifact-snapshot-coverage
455	# cycled sub-stage of the cyc cycle declares roles:[builder]
456	mock_plugin_factory "cycled" "agent" 0 "" "builder" >/dev/null
457	
458	# Write intake artifact and snapshot to the state branch so the state looks
459	# exactly like a run interrupted after intake (the state that would trigger
460	# auto-resume if the --no-resume guard were absent).
461	printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
462	    > "$S12_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"
463	
464	_s12_snap_rc=0
465	( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S12_STATE_DIR"
466	  cd "$S12_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S12_STATE_DIR" "$_S12_ID" ) \
467	    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s12_snap_rc=$?
468	if [[ "$_s12_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
469	    assert_fail "[#1805/SPEC-12] setup: snapshot to state branch failed" \
470	        "rc=$_s12_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
471	fi
472	# Remove the artifact from disk — only the state branch has it now, matching a
473	# real interrupted run where the workspace was cleaned between pipeline stages.
474	rm -f "$S12_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"
475	
476	# State: intake=complete, status=interrupted — exactly what auto-resume would
477	# act on (skip intake) if the --no-resume flag were NOT passed.
478	# With --no-resume the runner must start fresh and dispatch all stages.
479	jq -n \
480	    --arg run_id "s12-fresh-1805" \
481	    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
482	    --argjson issue "$_S12_ID" \
483	    '{
484	        schema_version: 1,
485	        run_id: $run_id,
486	        issue: $issue,
487	        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete"},
488	        current_iteration: 0,
489	        self_heal_count: {},
490	        scope_manifest_hash: "",
491	        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
492	        claim_lease_id: "",
493	        plugin_state: {},
494	        status: "interrupted",
495	        updated_at: $now
496	    }' > "$S12_STATE_FILE"
497	
498	# Run WITH --no-resume: explicitly suppresses auto-resume detection.
499	# Without --no-resume, the runner would detect status=interrupted, call
500	# _runner_resume_rehydrate, and skip intake (0 stage.start events for intake).
501	# With --no-resume, the runner starts fresh: intake dispatches (1 stage.start).
502	# The assert_eq "1" below distinguishes this flag-guarded fresh run from a run
503	# that merely happens to have no completed stages in state.
504	set +e
505	( cd "$S12_WORK_REPO" && env \
506	    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
507	    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S12_STATE_DIR" \
508	    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S12_STATE_FILE" \
509	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S12_EVENTS_DIR" \
510	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" \
511	    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
512	    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
513	    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
514	    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=1 \
515	    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
516	    bash "$RUNNER" --template artifact-snapshot-coverage --no-resume --issue "$_S12_ID" ) \
517	    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stderr.txt"
518	set -e
519	
520	# [#1805/SPEC-12]: intake must emit stage.start on a fresh run (not skipped by
521	# rehydration, which only applies on resume). This pins the new-run side of the
522	# ADR-050 §6 boundary: the prior-work reuse invariant governs new runs; a resume
523	# (governed by ADR-006) is the only path that may skip complete stages.
524	_s12_intake_starts=0
525	if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
526	    _s12_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
527	        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
528	fi
529	assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches intake (not skipped; ADR-050 §6 new-run side)" \
530	    "1" "$_s12_intake_starts"
531	
532	# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycled sub-stage must dispatch (cycle executed; no stage skipped).
533	# Before fix: ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 suppresses the cycle → cycled_starts=0 → assert_gt fails.
534	# After fix: cycles enabled, cycled sub-stage runs for the 1 configured iteration → PASSES.
535	_s12_cycled_starts=0
536	if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
537	    _s12_cycled_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
538	        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^cycled$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
539	fi
540	assert_gt "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches cycled sub-stage (cycle ran; no stage skipped)" \
541	    "$_s12_cycled_starts" "0"
542	
543	# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycle fixture used for this fresh-run sub-case contains type: cycle,
544	# establishing that the fixture IS a cyclic pipeline (satisfying the "same cycle fixture" clause).
545	_s12_fixt_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
546	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-12] cycle fixture used in SPEC-12 fresh-run sub-case has type: cycle" \
547	    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"
548	
549	# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
550	print_test_section "resume-rehydrate test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"
551	
552	# : the fixture must contain type: cycle (satisfies "containing a cyclic stage").
553	# Already read into _s12_fixt_content above from artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml.
554	assert_contains "resume-rehydrate fixture contains type: cycle" \
555	    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"
556	
557	# : a pipeline using that cyclic fixture was actually run in this test.
558	# _s12_cycled_starts was computed in the SPEC-12 section from the S12 pipeline run.
559	# Before fix: ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 → cycled never dispatches → 0 → assert_gt fails.
560	# After fix (cycles enabled, max_iter=1): cycled dispatches → assert_gt passes.
561	assert_gt "resume-rehydrate: pipeline with cyclic fixture was actually run (cycled dispatched)" \
562	    "$_s12_cycled_starts" "0"
563	
564	cleanup_test_env
565	print_test_results
566	exit $((FAIL > 0))
567

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: resume rehydrates completed-stage artifacts from the git state branch
# before the dispatch loop. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)
#
# SPEC-1 [code]: on resume, runner calls _artifact_persist_restore +
#   _artifact_persist_put_back and places completed-stage artifacts into
#   ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the dispatch loop; the complete stage emits
#   no stage.start event.
#
# SPEC-2 [code]: a complete stage whose primary artifact is absent from both
#   disk and the git state branch causes the resume to exit 1 before any
#   stage.start event is emitted.
#
# SPEC-5 [no-code]: ADR-006-resume-contract.md amended with step 3.5:
#   before the dispatch loop the runner restores completed-stage artifacts from
#   the git state branch; a still-absent artifact causes exit 1; enforcing
#   test names added inline.
#
# SPEC-6 [no-code]: ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md §6 amended with
#   boundary note: the invariant applies to new runs; a resume continues the
#   same run and is governed by ADR-006.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
RUNNER="$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/runner.sh"
ZBUILD_CLI="$REPO_ROOT/scripts/zbuild"
ADR_006="$REPO_ROOT/docs/adr/ADR-006-resume-contract.md"
ADR_050="$REPO_ROOT/docs/adr/ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/state/artifact-persist.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/state/artifact-persist.sh"

print_test_header "resume-rehydrate — artifact restore on resume (#1805)"
setup_test_env "resume-rehydrate-1805"
export ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn

_ZB_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"

# ── Shared infrastructure ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Create a git repo that the runner will use (CWD of the subprocess).
# The state branch is written here; the runner also reads from here.
WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-rehydrate-work)"
git -C "$WORK_REPO" config user.email t@e.st
git -C "$WORK_REPO" config user.name t

install_template_overlay "$WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

# Create mock plugins (intake + build, each declaring a primary artifact).
mock_plugin_factory "intake" "agent" 0 >/dev/null
mock_plugin_factory "build"  "agent" 0 >/dev/null
PLUGINS_ROOT="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/plugins"

# ── SPEC-1: resume rehydrates artifacts from git state branch ─────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] resume restores completed-stage artifact into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR"

S1_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-state"
S1_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-events"
S1_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1_STATE_FILE="$S1_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1_EVENTS_DIR"

# Write the intake primary artifact so the snapshot captures it.
printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Snapshot the artifact onto the state branch in WORK_REPO.
_s1_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1_STATE_DIR" "$_ZB_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "[#1805/SPEC-1] setup: snapshot to state branch failed" \
        "rc=$_s1_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
else
    assert_pass "[#1805/SPEC-1] setup: state branch populated with intake-result.json"
fi

# Remove the artifact from disk to simulate the "artifacts not on disk" scenario.
rm -f "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Write state file: intake=complete, build=pending.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s1-resume-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_ZB_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1_STATE_FILE"

# Run runner --resume. CWD=WORK_REPO so _artifact_persist_restore finds the
# state branch. Capture rc; do not abort on failure.
set +e
( cd "$WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S1_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal --resume --issue "$_ZB_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-stderr.txt"
_s1_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-1]: artifact must be present in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after resume.
# Before the change: no rehydration → file absent → FAILS.
# After the change: rehydration copies artifact from state branch → PASSES.
assert_file_exists "[#1805/SPEC-1] intake-result.json rehydrated into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" \
    "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# [#1805/SPEC-1]: intake must NOT have a stage.start event (it was complete and skipped).
_s1_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s1_intake_starts="$(grep -c '"type":"stage.start"' "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" \
        | xargs | grep -c '^[1-9]' 2>/dev/null || true)"
    # More precise: count stage.start events whose data.stage == "intake"
    _s1_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] intake emits no stage.start (complete stage skipped)" \
    "0" "$_s1_intake_starts"

# ── SPEC-1 path 2: auto-resume on status=interrupted ─────────────────────────
# [#1805/SPEC-1] all entry paths: path 2 — auto-resume when status=interrupted.
# No --resume flag; runner detects interrupted status and auto-resumes.
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: auto-resume (status=interrupted) restores artifacts"

S1P2_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S1P2_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-state"
S1P2_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-events"
S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1P2_STATE_FILE="$S1P2_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR"
touch "$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL"

S1P2_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-reh-s1p2)"
install_template_overlay "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s1p2_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P2_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1P2_STATE_DIR" "$S1P2_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1p2_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1p2_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "setup s1p2: snapshot failed (rc=$_s1p2_snap_rc)" \
        "$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
fi
rm -f "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s1p2-reh-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S1P2_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0, self_heal_count: {}, scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0, claim_lease_id: "", plugin_state: {},
        status: "interrupted", updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1P2_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P2_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S1P2_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal --issue "$S1P2_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 artifact restored.
# Before change: no rehydration → absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume/interrupted): intake-result.json restored" \
    "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: content must match what was snapshotted to the git state branch.
# Proves the artifact was placed into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR FROM the git state branch, not
# reconstructed from another source. Before fix: file absent → cat empty → FAILS. After: PASSES.
_s1p2_artifact_content="$(cat "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"
assert_contains \
    "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume): artifact content placed into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR from git state branch" \
    "$_s1p2_artifact_content" "prior-run intake"

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: build must have dispatched (proving pipeline ran and events written).
# Before fix: path-2 auto-resume doesn't exist → runner exits without events → build_starts=0 → FAILS.
# After fix: runner auto-resumes, rehydrates, skips intake, dispatches build → build_starts=1 → PASSES.
_s1p2_build_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^build$' || echo 0)"
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume): build dispatched (pipeline ran via path-2 resume)" \
    "1" "$_s1p2_build_starts"

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: intake must NOT have a stage.start event.
_s1p2_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' || echo 0)"
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume): intake emits no stage.start (skipped)" \
    "0" "$_s1p2_intake_starts"

# ── SPEC-1 path 3: zbuild pipeline resume --run-id ───────────────────────────
# [#1805/SPEC-1] all entry paths: path 3 — zbuild pipeline resume --run-id.
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 3: zbuild pipeline resume --run-id restores artifacts"

S1P3_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S1P3_RUN_ID="s1p3-reh-1805"
S1P3_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-state"
S1P3_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-events"
S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1P3_STATE_FILE="$S1P3_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR"
touch "$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL"

S1P3_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-reh-s1p3)"
install_template_overlay "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s1p3_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P3_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1P3_STATE_DIR" "$S1P3_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1p3_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1p3_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "setup s1p3: snapshot failed (rc=$_s1p3_snap_rc)" \
        "$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
fi
rm -f "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "$S1P3_RUN_ID" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S1P3_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0, self_heal_count: {}, scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0, claim_lease_id: "", plugin_state: {},
        status: "interrupted", updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1P3_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P3_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$ZBUILD_CLI" pipeline resume \
        --run-id "$S1P3_RUN_ID" \
        --template runner-state-dir-minimal ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 3 artifact restored.
# Before change: zbuild resume path has no rehydration → absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 3 (zbuild pipeline resume): intake-result.json restored" \
    "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s12_intake_starts=0

    done < <(detect_platforms "$PWD" "$state_dir" 2>/dev/null)
    [[ ${#_DETECTED_PLATFORMS[@]} -eq 0 ]] && _DETECTED_PLATFORMS=("generic")

    if $resume_mode; then
        # ADR-025 (Wave 15-E #685): defensive sentinel cleanup at resume entry.
        # The normal SIGINT path's EXIT trap already disarms the sentinel
        # in `_runner_abort_trap`, but a hard kill (-9), host crash, or any
        # path that skipped the EXIT trap can leave a stale .abort.signal.
        # Without this disarm the first `_zbuild_check_abort` pre-flight in
        # the dispatch loop would observe the stale sentinel and abort the
        # resumed run immediately. Resume must always start from a clean
        # signal channel.
        _zbuild_disarm_abort_sentinel
        # ADR-006 §3.6 (#1805): restore completed-stage artifacts from the git
        # state branch before the dispatch loop, so complete stages have their
        # primary artifacts available. A still-absent artifact causes exit 1 at
        # the dispatch loop's stale-artifact check.
        _runner_resume_rehydrate "$_runner_issue" "$state_dir"
        eb_emit_event "pipeline.resume" "run_id=$_runner_run_id" "issue=$_runner_issue"

            warn "Skipping ahead to stage '$from_stage' as requested (--from-stage)"
            eb_emit_event "pipeline.skip_to_stage" "stage=$from_stage" "run_id=$_runner_run_id"
        fi

        # operator can answer "which engine graded this?" without archaeology.
        local _eng_sha="${_RUNNER_ENGINE_SHA:-$(_runner_engine_sha)}"
        local _eng_br="${_RUNNER_ENGINE_BRANCH:-$(_runner_engine_branch)}"
        eb_emit_event "pipeline.start" "run_id=$_runner_run_id" "issue=$_runner_issue" \
            "engine_sha=$_eng_sha" "engine_branch=$_eng_br"
        info "Pipeline started — run_id=$_runner_run_id issue=${issue:-} goal=${goal:-} template=$template engine=${_eng_sha:0:7}(${_eng_br})"
    fi

    # ── ADR-054 §11 (#1944): arm the run-level watchdog ─────────────────────
    # The watchdog is a background subshell that sleeps for the resolved limit,
    # then writes `timed_out` to the abort sentinel and sends SIGTERM to the
    # runner's process group. The EXIT trap kills the watchdog on clean exit.
    #
    # Raw kill (not zbuild_pg_kill): the watchdog IS in the runner's process
    # group, so zbuild_pg_kill's self-group guard would refuse the kill.
    # First-wins: the sentinel write happens BEFORE the signal, so if the
    # runner's SIGTERM trap calls _zbuild_arm_abort_sentinel "sigterm", ADR-025
    # first-wins preserves `timed_out` over that later write.
    local _RUNNER_RUN_PGID=""

        # can escalate to KILL after the grace period. The runner's EXIT trap

        # watchdog is SIGKILL'd before `sleep` returns) cannot hold the pipe

# ─── _runner_resume_rehydrate <issue> <state_dir> (#1805, ADR-006 §3.6) ─────
# Restore completed-stage artifacts from the git state branch into the
# artifact area before the dispatch loop runs. Non-fatal on restore failure;
# a still-absent artifact is caught by the dispatch loop's stale-artifact
# check which now exits 1 instead of warning-and-continuing (SPEC-2 / SPEC-9).
_runner_resume_rehydrate() {
    local _rr_issue="$1" _rr_state_dir="$2"
    local _rr_artifacts_dir="$_rr_state_dir/artifacts"
    local _rr_staging="$_rr_state_dir/resume-rehydrate.staging"
    rm -rf "$_rr_staging" 2>/dev/null || true
    _artifact_persist_restore "$_rr_issue" "$_rr_staging" || {
        rm -rf "${_rr_staging:?}" 2>/dev/null || true
        return 0
    }
    if [[ -d "$_rr_staging/artifacts" ]]; then
        _artifact_persist_put_back "$_rr_staging/artifacts" "$_rr_artifacts_dir" || true
    fi
    rm -rf "${_rr_staging:?}" 2>/dev/null || true
    return 0
}

# ─── _runner_from_stage_preflight <stages_arr> <from_stage> <state_dir> <plugins_root> ─
# For --from-stage <s>: restore + put_back artifacts from the git state branch,
# then verify every stage before <s> has its primary artifact in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR.
# Exits 1 naming the missing stage in stderr. (SPEC-3, SPEC-4, ADR-006 §3.6)
_runner_from_stage_preflight() {
    local -n _fsp_stages="$1"
    local _fsp_from_stage="$2" _fsp_state_dir="$3" _fsp_plugins_root="$4"
    local _fsp_artifacts_dir="$_fsp_state_dir/artifacts"
    local _fsp_staging="$_fsp_state_dir/from-stage-preflight.staging"
    rm -rf "$_fsp_staging" 2>/dev/null || true
    # Restore + put_back (same sequence as _runner_resume_rehydrate)
    _artifact_persist_restore "$_runner_issue" "$_fsp_staging" || true
    if [[ -d "$_fsp_staging/artifacts" ]]; then
        _artifact_persist_put_back "$_fsp_staging/artifacts" "$_fsp_artifacts_dir" || true
    fi
    rm -rf "${_fsp_staging:?}" 2>/dev/null || true
    # Verify every stage before the target has its primary artifact
    local _fsp_s _fsp_plugin_dir _fsp_manifest _fsp_prim_path _fsp_resolved
    for _fsp_s in "${_fsp_stages[@]}"; do
        [[ "$_fsp_s" == "$_fsp_from_stage" ]] && break
        _fsp_plugin_dir=""; _fsp_manifest=""; _fsp_prim_path=""; _fsp_resolved=""
        _fsp_plugin_dir="$(_find_plugin_for_stage "$_fsp_s" "$_fsp_plugins_root" 2>/dev/null || true)"
        [[ -z "$_fsp_plugin_dir" ]] && continue
        _fsp_manifest="$_fsp_plugin_dir/manifest.yaml"
        _fsp_prim_path="$(_verdict_primary_output_path "$_fsp_manifest" 2>/dev/null || true)"
        [[ -z "$_fsp_prim_path" ]] && continue
        _fsp_resolved="$(_verdict_resolve_path "$_fsp_prim_path" "$_fsp_state_dir")"
        if [[ ! -s "$_fsp_resolved" ]]; then
            echo "error: --from-stage '$_fsp_from_stage': stage '$_fsp_s' has no restorable primary artifact" >&2
            return 1
        fi
    done
    return 0
}

_artifact_persist_restore() {
    _artifact_persist_reset_status

    #   2. the old guard tested `-d "$repo_root/.git"`, which is FALSE in a linked
    #      worktree because .git is a file there — restore would silently no-op and
    #      prior artifacts would never come back, with no error to notice.
    local _gd=""
    [[ -n "$repo_root" ]] && _artifact_persist_git_dir_v _gd "$repo_root"
    [[ -z "$restored_dir" ]] && { _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_STATUS="failed"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON="no restored_dir given"; return 2; }

        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_STATUS="failed"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON="unresolvable repo: repo_root=[${repo_root:-<empty>}] git_dir=[${_gd:-<empty>}] cwd=[$PWD]"
        return 1
    fi

    local ref=""

        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_SOURCE="local"
    elif GIT_DIR="$_gd" git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/remotes/origin/$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        ref="refs/remotes/origin/$branch"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_SOURCE="remote"

        # early return here that is NOT a failure.
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_STATUS="empty"
        _ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON="no $branch locally or on origin (first run)"

    _CYCLE_LAST_HISTORY_FILE="$history_file"

Now I can see the issue. The cycle-orchestrator reads `current_iter` unconditionally at line 2306-2309:

```bash
local _persisted_iter
_persisted_iter="$(get_state_field "$state_file" \
    ".cycle_iterations[\"$cycle_id\"].current_iter" 0 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
[[ "$_persisted_iter" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || _persisted_iter=0
local _start_iter=$(( _persisted_iter + 1 ))
```

This is the bug! When a FRESH run has a nested loop, the inner cycle starts. After the first outer iteration, `current_iter` in state has the value from the previous iteration (e.g., 2 if the inner cycle ran 2 iterations). The fix is to guard the iteration read with the resume flag: outside resume mode, the inner cycle should always start at iteration 1. I also want to check the resume-loop-state test and where `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` gets exported.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: cycle orchestrator reads persisted current_iter and starts the
# iteration loop from that value (not 1) on resume. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)
#
# SPEC-7 [code]: Cycle orchestrator reads cycle_iterations[CYCLE_ID].current_iter
#   from persisted state at resume and starts the iteration loop from that value
#   (not 1); iter-1 complete stages emit no stage.start on resume into iter-2.
#   Its test must FAIL on the code as it was before this change.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
FIXT="$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"

print_test_header "resume-loop-state — cycle orchestrator resumes from persisted iter (#1805)"
setup_test_env "resume-loop-state-1805"

export ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json"
export ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/events"
export ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/state"
mkdir -p "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR" "$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR"

# shellcheck source=../../core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/pipeline/template.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/template.sh"
# shellcheck source=../lib/cycle-report-stub.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/cycle-report-stub.sh"

STATE_FILE="$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"

# ── SPEC-7: cycle starts from persisted current_iter on resume ─────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-7] cycle orchestrator resumes from current_iter (not 1)"

# Seed minimal state file required by _cycle_state_init.
: > "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL"
jq -n '{schema_version:1, stage_statuses:{}, updated_at:"seed"}' > "$STATE_FILE"

# Use zb_engine_loop_state to write one completed iteration (current_iter=1)
# into the state file. This simulates: iter-1 of the cycle has run and
# completed; the run was then interrupted before iter-2 dispatched.
# After the change the orchestrator will read current_iter=1 and start from
# iter-2 (current_iter + 1). Before the change it starts from iter=1.
zb_engine_loop_state "$STATE_FILE" "build-test" 1 5 "in_progress"

# Load the cycle template.
load_template "$FIXT/cycle-converges-iter2.yaml"

# Mock cycle_dispatch_stage: record the first iter dispatched, always pass.
# We record across all stages because the very first dispatch call reveals
# which iter the orchestrator started from.
_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=-1
cycle_dispatch_stage() {
    local stage="$1" iter="$2"
    if [[ "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER" -eq -1 ]]; then
        _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER="$iter"
    fi
    _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT="pass"
    _CYCLE_DISPATCH_STATUS="complete"
    return 0
}

# The report stub makes the test member report zero test failures (pass).
zb_stub_reports_tests test

# Run the cycle orchestrator against the seeded state.
# Before this change: loop starts at iter=1 → first dispatch is iter=1.
# After this change: loop reads current_iter=1 → starts at iter=2 → first is 2.
set +e
cycle_orchestrator_run "build-test" "$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR" "$STATE_FILE"
_s7_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-7]: first dispatched iter must be 2, not 1.
# Before the change: _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=1 → assert 2==1 → FAILS.
# After the change:  _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=2 → assert 2==2 → PASSES.
assert_eq \
    "[#1805/SPEC-7] first dispatched iter is 2 (resumed from current_iter=1, not restarted from 1)" \
    "2" "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER"

# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
print_test_section "resume-loop-state test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

# cycle-converges-iter2.yaml is loaded above via load_template and driven through
# cycle_orchestrator_run. Assert it contains type: cycle to formally pin the fixture
# contains a cyclic stage (as this test's SPEC-13 contract requires).
_s13_loop_fixt_content="$(cat "$FIXT/cycle-converges-iter2.yaml")"
assert_contains "cycle fixture used by resume-loop-state test has type: cycle" \
    "$_s13_loop_fixt_content" "type: cycle"

# Also assert the pipeline was actually run: cycle_dispatch_stage was invoked
# during cycle_orchestrator_run above, setting _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER from its
# initial -1.  A value > -1 proves the cyclic stage was dispatched.
assert_gt \
    "resume-loop-state ran the cyclic pipeline (cycle_dispatch_stage was invoked)" \
    "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER" "-1"

cleanup_test_env
print_test_results
exit $((FAIL > 0))

_setup_path_state() {
    local label="$1" issue_id="$2"

    P_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo "ep-${label}")"
    install_template_overlay "$P_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

    P_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-state"
    P_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-events"
    P_STATE_FILE="$P_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
    P_EVENTS_JSONL="$P_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
    mkdir -p "$P_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$P_EVENTS_DIR"

    # Write the intake artifact so the snapshot captures it.
    printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
        > "$P_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

    # Snapshot onto the state branch.
    local _snap_rc=0
    ( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$P_STATE_DIR"
      cd "$P_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$P_STATE_DIR" "$issue_id" ) \
        >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-snap.log" 2>&1 || _snap_rc=$?
    if [[ "$_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
        assert_fail "setup-${label}: snapshot to state branch failed" \
            "rc=$_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
    fi

    # Remove artifact from disk; it now lives only on the state branch.
    rm -f "$P_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"
}

# cycle_dispatch_stage hook — F1 uses the same per-stage path that the
    # legacy stage loop uses. Returns the stage's rc; the orchestrator owns the
    # iteration semantics. Sets _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT / _CYCLE_DISPATCH_STATUS
    # so the orchestrator can score until/plateau/divergence.
    cycle_dispatch_stage() {
        local _cd_stage="$1" _cd_iter="$2" _cd_state="$3"
        _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT=""
        _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT_RAW=""
        _CYCLE_DISPATCH_STATUS=""
        _CYCLE_DISPATCH_REASON=""
        _CYCLE_DISPATCH_DISPOSITION=""
        _CYCLE_DISPATCH_REPORT="{}"
        _CYCLE_DISPATCH_DATA_KIND=""
        local _cd_plugin_dir _cd_rc=0
        # #1783: refresh the contract-reader snapshot before EVERY member, so a
        # gate reads the lib copy build just wrote rather than the previous
        # iteration's. No-op unless this run edits one of those libs.
        _runner_refresh_contract_snapshot "$state_dir" || true
        # ADR-042: resolve role-then-id (uniform with leaf + parallel paths) so a
        # role-bound cycle member whose plugin id ≠ stage name resolves correctly.
        _cd_plugin_dir="$(resolve_stage_plugin "$_cd_stage" "$plugins_root" 2>/dev/null || true)"
        if [[ -z "$_cd_plugin_dir" ]]; then
            _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT="error"
            _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT_RAW="error"

get_resume_recommendation() {
    local state_file="$1"

    if [[ ! -f "$state_file" ]]; then
        echo "fresh_start"
        return 0
    fi

    local status updated_at
    status="$(get_state_field "$state_file" '.status' '')"
    updated_at="$(get_state_field "$state_file" '.updated_at' '')"

    case "$status" in
        complete|"")
            echo "fresh_start"
            ;;
        aborted|timed_out)
            echo "manual_resume_only"
            ;;
        interrupted)
            echo "auto_resume"
            ;;
        in_progress)
            # Check if last update was within 24 hours
            if [[ -z "$updated_at" ]]; then
                echo "manual_resume_only"
                return 0
            fi
            local updated_epoch now_epoch age_seconds
            updated_epoch="$(_zbuild_iso8601_to_epoch "$updated_at")"
            now_epoch="$(date -u +%s)"
            age_seconds=$(( now_epoch - updated_epoch ))
            if [[ $age_seconds -lt 86400 ]]; then
                echo "auto_resume"
            else
                echo "manual_resume_only"
            fi
            ;;
        *)
            echo "fresh_start"
            ;;
    esac
    return 0
}
